#note: Based on the OB version, the line has been restored to @akk{LIMMU#-im m[u-uš-tak-nu} @i{šikitti}], see @bib{RN239@166 and 212}. Nevertheless, the unusual writing of the assumed @i{arbaʾu}, as well as the use of @akk{mu} instead of the expected @akk{muš} left the question open for alternative restorations. The one adopted here follows a suggestion by E. Jiménez (pers. comm.).
